reason: A DeepSeek Harness HUD that monitors session token pressure, estimated model costs, account balance, and persisted daily or monthly usage through an interactive dashboard.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供常驻 HUD，用于查看会话 Token 压力、模型成本估算、余额和按日或按月的用量统计。
summaries.en: A persistent DeepSeek Harness HUD for viewing session token pressure, model cost estimates, balance, and daily or monthly usage statistics.

capabilities: Reads session token usage and context-pressure metrics
Displays model-based cost estimates and daily or monthly usage trends
Reads account balance through the host API when available
Persists usage statistics and local panel settings
Allows users to edit a local budget and balance value
